source_note: C01 portable generator (blueprint p.7: 6 PU, no fuel depletion, placed at the pump pad; pump OR pub, never both). Anchors are authored placement points; routes are the grid edges a placed generator can be cabled into from that anchor. Cables are authored curves between sockets (presentation only), never physics. position_cm are PLACEHOLDERS (pump house from blueprint p.6 at about (60, 16) m; van guessed) until the V01 graybox places the anchors; a dropped or misplaced item snaps to the nearest free anchor (blueprint p.6).
